name: Invisible Ships — Core Concepts

basis_legend.documented: a source, ruling or official record supports it directly
basis_legend.structural: it follows from what the dataset does or does not contain
basis_legend.pattern: an observation drawn from experience, offered as an observation
basis_legend.testimony: a dated first-person report of what the author experienced or was told, verified by nobody

axes.basis: how much weight the entry carries — see basis_legend
axes.theme: what it is about; seven values, in the frontmatter of every concept
axes.audience: who it was written for; five values, and most concepts carry more than one

origin_legend.ai: derived by AI analysis of the dataset
origin_legend.author: the author's own observation, from experience

reading_rule: The basis tiers are ranked and never blended inside a single concept. A reader who accepts only `documented` entries can rely on every one of those and discard the rest without unpicking anything.
